parameters.query: select p.id as prospect_id, p.borr_name, p.borr_city, p.borr_state, p.outreach_status, p.computed_lead_score from public.sba_prospects p where ({{ $json.from_email ? `'${$json.from_email.replace(/'/g, "''")}'` : 'null' }} is not null and lower(btrim(coalesce(p.owner_email, ''))) = {{ $json.from_email ? `'${$json.from_email.replace(/'/g, "''")}'` : 'null' }}) or ({{ $json.from_phone_digits ? `'${$json.from_phone_digits.replace(/\D/g, '')}'` : 'null' }} is not null and length({{ $json.from_phone_digits ? `'${$json.from_phone_digits.replace(/\D/g, '')}'` : "''" }}) >= 10 and (right(regexp_replace(coalesce(p.owner_phone, ''), '\D', '', 'g'), 10) = {{ $json.from_phone_digits ? `'${$json.from_phone_digits.replace(/\D/g, '')}'` : 'null' }} or right(regexp_replace(coalesce(p.google_phone, ''), '\D', '', 'g'), 10) = {{ $json.from_phone_digits ? `'${$json.from_phone_digits.replace(/\D/g, '')}'` : 'null' }})) order by p.computed_lead_score desc limit 1;

insert into public.sba_outreach_touches (prospect_id, external_event_id, channel, direction, sequence_name, sequence_step, subject_line, message_summary, outcome, reply_sentiment, reply_excerpt, next_followup_at, occurred_at) values ('{{ $("Match SBA Prospect").item.json.prospect_id }}'::uuid, '{{ $("Normalize & Classify").item.json.external_event_id.replace(/'/g, "''") }}', 'inbound_reply'::public.outreach_channel_type, 'inbound'::public.touch_direction_type, 'INBOUND_WEBHOOK', 1, '{{ $("Normalize & Classify").item.json.subject_line.replace(/'/g, "''") }}', '{{ $("Normalize & Classify").item.json.message_summary.replace(/'/g, "''") }}', '{{ $("Normalize & Classify").item.json.outcome }}'::public.touch_outcome_type, '{{ $("Normalize & Classify").item.json.reply_sentiment }}', '{{ $("Normalize & Classify").item.json.reply_excerpt.replace(/'/g, "''") }}', null, '{{ $("Normalize & Classify").item.json.occurred_at }}'::timestamptz) on conflict (external_event_id) do nothing returning id, prospect_id, outcome, occurred_at;

parameters.text: ={{ `Unmatched Inbound ${$('Normalize & Classify').item.json.source_channel.toUpperCase()} Reply — From: ${$('Normalize & Classify').item.json.from_email || $('Normalize & Classify').item.json.from_phone_raw || 'unknown'}\n> ${$('Normalize & Classify').item.json.reply_excerpt}` }}
